edges.relationship: 420kV transformers and reactors to Statnett (Norway TSO)

contracts.signal: Section XI (filed 08-13-2026): '420kV transformer etc. supply contract' with Statnett SF, disclosed 11-09-2023 (amended 06-18-2025, 02-10-2026), contract 2023-11-08 to 2028-05-31, total KRW 113,586M; H1 2026 deliveries/billing KRW 21,551M (cumulative KRW 21,551M), cash received KRW 21,759M in H1 (cumulative KRW 26,965M); some transformers sold June 2026, remainder after factory test and shipping.

Section XI (filed 08-13-2026): second '420kV transformer etc. supply contract' with Statnett SF, disclosed 07-08-2024 (amended 06-18-2025, 01-08-2026, 02-26-2026), contract 2024-07-05 to 2032-01-30, total KRW 372,324M; nothing delivered or collected yet (first payment milestone not reached), deliveries to start in 2027 after factory testing. Statnett was 1.89% of parent H1 2026 revenue.
